item.title: Grocery inflation edges up to 2.6% as sales of essentials jump
item.body: Supermarket prices are 2.6% higher than a year ago, up from 2.5% last month, data from Worldpanel by Numerator shows. Sales of essentials jumped for the 'Be Ready' campaign.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📊 Grocery inflation edges up to 2.6% as sales of essentials jump

Supermarket prices are 2.6% higher than a year ago, up from 2.5% last month, data from Worldpanel by Numerator shows. Sales of essentials jumped for the 'Be Ready' campaign.

Source: Evening Standard | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 10 November, 08:50
